description: Multiple requested capabilities each conflict with the architecture constraints: direct card-processor calls from the app (forbidden, ConnectedPaymentGateway), an unsigned hotfix OTA (forbidden, Code Signing Authority), automatic rollback of an ADAS update (forbidden, ISO 26262), and 5-second cloud telemetry polling (forbidden, <30s). The Gap Detector must flag at least the payment and OTA conflicts, ideally all four.
